central_target: For Q=[k]G, compute Y_G(x(Q))/y(Q)=(-1)^k without materializing Y_G or using scalar-indexed advice.

scope.curves: the five frozen prime-order toy curves y^2=x^3+7 already used by PARITY-LIFT-000
scope.purpose: discover or reject small transferable sign circuits before any secp256k1 specialization

uniformity_rule.required: the identical symbolic atom list and circuit topology must compile unchanged on every validation curve
forbidden: tables indexed by the hidden scalar
coefficients of the materialized polynomial Y_G
discarding zeros or poles after seeing the target labels
allowed_public_constants: the two nontrivial cube roots beta and beta^2 selected canonically by field order

composition.semantic_quotient: atoms with identical sign vectors on the requested validation subset are interchangeable only for exact search; the lowest declared cost representative is retained

admission_gates: defined and nonzero on every nonidentity subgroup point of every admitted curve
same symbolic formula on at least three structurally distinct curves
holdout curves are evaluated without coefficient refitting
all field, inversion, group, character, sign and public-constant costs are reported
a finite transfer seed is not called a uniform asymptotic evaluator
symbolic lifting starts only after an unchanged multi-curve exact candidate exists
claim_boundary: Absence of a circuit in this bounded grammar is only a scoped negative. Presence of a toy transfer circuit is only a seed requiring proof and asymptotic analysis.
